arxiv-2012-04979.title: Representation Extraction and Deep Neural Recommendation for Collaborative Filtering
arxiv-2012-04979.creator: Arash Khoeini, Saman Haratizadeh, Ehsan Hoseinzade
arxiv-2012-04979.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Arash Khoeini, Saman Haratizadeh, Ehsan Hoseinzade. Many Deep Learning approaches solve complicated classification and regression problems by hierarchically constructing complex features from the raw input data. Although a few works have investigated the application of deep neural networks in recommendation domain, they mostly extract entity features by exploiting unstructured auxiliary data such as visual and textual information, and when it comes to using user-item rating matrix, feature extraction is done by using matrix factorization.

arxiv-2112-10144.title: Physical Properties and Impact Parameter Variations of Kepler Planets from Analytic Light Curve Modeling
arxiv-2112-10144.creator: Yair Judkovsky, Aviv Ofir, Oded Aharonson
arxiv-2112-10144.description: Abstract We apply AnalyticLC , an analytic model described in an accompanying paper, to interpret Kepler data of systems that contain two or three transiting planets. We perform tests to verify that the obtained solutions agree with full N-body integrations, and that the number of model parameters is statistically justified.

arxiv-2203-08298.title: Modeling of Asymptotically Periodic Outbreaks: a long-term SIRW2 description of Covid-19?
arxiv-2203-08298.creator: Alex Viguerie, Margherita Carletti, Alessandro Veneziani, Guido Silvestri
arxiv-2203-08298.description: Abstract As the outbreak of COVID-19 enters its third year, we have now enough data to analyse the behavior of the pandemic with mathematical models over a long period of time. The pandemic alternates periods of high and low infections, in a way that sheds a light on the nature of mathematical model that can be used for reliable predictions.

arxiv-2203-14291.title: Video Polyp Segmentation: A Deep Learning Perspective
arxiv-2203-14291.creator: Ge-Peng Ji † \dagger, Guobao Xiao † \dagger, Yu-Cheng Chou † \dagger, Deng-Ping Fan 🖂, Kai Zhao, Geng Chen, Luc Van Gool
arxiv-2203-14291.description: Abstract We present the first comprehensive video polyp segmentation (VPS) study in the deep learning era. Over the years, developments in VPS are not moving forward with ease due to the lack of a large-scale dataset with fine-grained segmentation annotations.

arxiv-2204-10762.title: Dite-HRNet: Dynamic Lightweight High-Resolution Network for Human Pose Estimation
arxiv-2204-10762.creator: Qun Li, Ziyi Zhang, Fu Xiao, Feng Zhang, Bir Bhanu
arxiv-2204-10762.description: Abstract A high-resolution network exhibits remarkable capability in extracting multi-scale features for human pose estimation, but fails to capture long-range interactions between joints and has high computational complexity. To address these problems, we present a Dynamic lightweight High-Resolution Network (Dite-HRNet), which can efficiently extract multi-scale contextual information and model long-range spatial dependency for human pose estimation.

arxiv-2207-12020.title: Domain-invariant Feature Exploration for Domain Generalization
arxiv-2207-12020.creator: Wang Lu luwang@ict.ac.cn, Jindong Wang jindong.wang@microsoft.com, Haoliang Li haoliang.li@cityu.edu.hk, Yiqiang Chen yqchen@ict.ac.cn, Xing Xie xingx@microsoft.com
arxiv-2207-12020.description: Abstract Deep learning has achieved great success in the past few years. However, the performance of deep learning is likely to impede in face of non-IID situations. Domain generalization (DG) enables a model to generalize to an unseen test distribution, i.e., to learn domain-invariant representations.

arxiv-2306-13056.title: Gain-loss-induced non-Abelian Bloch braids
arxiv-2306-13056.creator: Bikashkali Midya
arxiv-2306-13056.description: Abstract Onsite gain-loss-induced topological braiding principle of non-Hermitian energy bands is theoretically formulated in multiband lattice models with Hermitian hopping amplitudes. Braid phase transition occurs when the gain-loss parameter is tuned across exceptional point degeneracy. Laboratory realizable effective-Hamiltonians are proposed to realize braid groups 𝔹 2 \mathbb{B}_{2} and 𝔹 3 \mathbb{B}_{3} of two and three bands, respectively.

arxiv-2309-07977.title: A Schiffer-type problem for annuli with applications to stationary planar Euler flows
arxiv-2309-07977.creator: Alberto Enciso, Antonio J. Fernández, David Ruiz, Pieralberto Sicbaldi
arxiv-2309-07977.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alberto Enciso, Antonio J. Fernández, David Ruiz, Pieralberto Sicbaldi. arxiv-2410-00696.title: Stroboscopic averaging methods to study autoresonance and other problems with slowly varying forcing frequencies
arxiv-2410-00696.creator: M.P. Calvo, J.M. Sanz-Serna, Beibei Zhu
arxiv-2410-00696.description: Abstract Autoresonance is a phenomenon of physical interest that may take place when a nonlinear oscillator is forced at a frequency that varies slowly. The stroboscopic averaging method (SAM), which provides an efficient numerical technique for the integration of highly oscillatory systems, cannot be used directly to study autoresonance due to the slow changes of the forcing frequency.

arxiv-2501-08141.title: Magnetic Field Structures In and Around Seyfert Galaxy Outflows
arxiv-2501-08141.creator: Salmoli Ghosh, Preeti Kharb, Biny Sebastian, Jack Gallimore, Alice Pasetto, Christopher P. O’Dea, Timothy Heckman, Stefi A. Baum
arxiv-2501-08141.description: Abstract We present radio polarimetric images of 12 Seyfert and Low-Ionization Nuclear Emission-line Region (LINER) galaxies belonging to the Centre for Astrophysics (CfA)+12 micron sample exhibiting kiloparsec-scale radio outflows (KSRs). These observations have been carried out at 10 GHz with Karl G. Jansky Very Large Array (VLA) in D-array and at 1.

arxiv-2506-04821.title: LogicPuzzleRL: Cultivating Robust Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2506-04821.creator: Zhen Hao Wong, Jingwen Deng, Runming He, Zirong Chen, Qijie You
arxiv-2506-04821.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhen Hao Wong, Jingwen Deng, Runming He, Zirong Chen, Qijie You. Large language models (LLMs) excel at many supervised tasks but often struggle with structured reasoning in unfamiliar settings. This discrepancy suggests that standard fine-tuning pipelines may instill narrow, domain-specific heuristics rather than fostering general-purpose thinking strategies.

pmc-12461182.title: ERK-driven autophagy enhances synergy of eribulin and cisplatin in triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-12461182.creator: Hyemi Ko, Myungsun Lee, Eunyoung Cha, Jinsun Lee
pmc-12461182.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) remains one of the most aggressive subtypes of breast cancer with limited therapeutic options, especially in resource-limited settings. The present study investigated the mechanistic synergy of eribulin and cisplatin in TNBC, with a focus on ERK-driven autophagy. MDA-MB-231 TNBC cells were treated with eribulin and cisplatin.

pmc-12590853.title: Serum IgG N-glycans act as serum biomarkers for differentiation of cold and heat pattern in rheumatoid arthritis
pmc-12590853.creator: Yilin Wang, Yu Lai, Jingrong Wang, Jiaqi Wu, Hao Yu, Yao Xiao, Liang Liu, Zishao Zhong, Hudan Pan
pmc-12590853.description: BackgroundTo develop and validate a panel of serum IgG N-glycan biomarkers for both the diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and the differentiation of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) syndromes in RA patients.MethodsWe conducted a case–control study involving 105 patients meeting the 2010 American College of Rheumatology/European Alliance against Rheumatism RA classification criteria and 79 healthy controls.

pmc-12606334.title: Argo Delphi consensus statement on red flags and clinical gateways towards rare disease diagnosis
pmc-12606334.creator: Giuseppe Limongelli, Fabio De Iaco, Marta Mosca, Leandro Pecchia, Gaetano Piccinocchi, Luca Sangiorgi, Maurizio Scarpa, Davide Cafiero, Lucia Politi, Fabio Tedone, Amalia Forte, Martina Caiazza, Chiara De Stasio, Anna Fusco, Barbara Morgillo, Iris Scala, Annalisa Scopinaro, Paola Facchin, Giuseppina
pmc-12606334.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). People living with a rare disease can wait months to years for a confirmed diagnosis after symptom onset, mainly due to low prevalence, lack of awareness of primary healthcare professionals, heterogeneous clinical presentation and/or peculiar inheritance patterns. This consensus paper aims to establish a set of guidelines to assist healthcare professionals—also without a specialized expertise in rare diseases—in optimizing the diagnostic pathway for these conditions.

pmc-12611635.title: From Logistic Regression to Foundation Models: Factors Associated With Improved Forecasts
pmc-12611635.creator: Abdulazeez Alabi, Olajide Akinpeloye, Osayimwense Izinyon, Tope Amusa, Akinwale Famotire
pmc-12611635.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Chronic‑disease risk models using electronic health record (EHR) data inform screening and resource allocation. Calibration (expected calibration error, slope, and intercept), transportability under temporal or site shifts, and decision utility (net benefit) govern the clinical value. Narrative synthesis of comparative studies from January 2019 to October 8, 2025, appraised classical regression and gradient‑boosted decision tree (GBDT) models against deep neural networks (DNNs) and foundation backbones.

pmc-13228911.title: Results of Injury Surveillance for Personal Mobility Devices and Their Applications
pmc-13228911.creator: Sangyeon Park, Jungeun Lee, Eunhee Jeon, 상연 박, 정은 이, 은희 전
pmc-13228911.description: ObjectivesPersonal mobility devices (PMDs) have rapidly gained recognition as an innovative and convenient means of transportation. However, the continuous increase in the use of these devices also raises the number of injuries. Therefore, this study aimed to conduct an in-depth analysis of injury surveillance statistics, disseminate the findings, and promote a culture of safe PMD use.

pmc-13621578.title: Rare clinical presentation of invasive pulmonary aspergillosis in patient with early-stage lung cancer: a case report
pmc-13621578.creator: Tatjana Adzić-Vukicevic, Sead Dalifi, Katarina Petkovic, Milan Savic, Katarina Lukic, Dragana Sobic-Saranovic, Jon Salmanton-García
pmc-13621578.description: Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis (IPA) presents life-threatening complication mostly seen in patients with severe neutropenia or in patients with solid organ cancers after applied anticancer therapy. The aim of this manuscript is to identify clinical manifestations of IPA in lung cancer patient.
